# Renamed cm_ -> bcm_ and nothing else; rebuild after a CM update.
#
# Only the blocks this mod's maps reach: bcm_location_rgo_blocks_urbanize, bcm_location_deurbanize_would_undo


# Root is the location. Reads the owner rather than scope:bcm_country because the finder's
# governor filter calls it from a sweep that sets no scope.
# True when the location's RGO good is checked in the owner's do-not-urbanize list.
bcm_location_rgo_blocks_urbanize = {
	raw_material = { save_temporary_scope_as = bcm_rgo_good }
	owner = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bcm_auto_urbanize_ignored_rgo_goods target = scope:bcm_rgo_good } }
}

# Root is the location. Ground the de-urbanizer will take the rank off, asked of a site a capital
# or a governor is about to be placed on. Carries no rank test: a governor site below city rank is
# one the plan urbanizes first, which is exactly the case worth refusing.
bcm_location_deurbanize_would_undo = {
	owner = { exists = var:bcm_deurbanize }
	is_market_center = no
	bcm_location_rgo_blocks_urbanize = yes
}
